description: Fire Sprite / Demon, default look, from the reference sheet's five palette chips (sampled from design/reference/firesprite-character-sheet.webp: charcoal 65,55,56 and 81,72,72; orange 249,121,53 and 250,143,61; dark red 160,45,28) plus the sheet's pale-yellow eye glow and dark ember face. The body is PURE HELLFIRE graded through glow tiers: dark ember face shadow < dark-red lick + limb tips < orange body < bright-orange rising tongues < yellow-orange hot core (seen through the shell) < eye/mouth hole walls < pale-yellow hole floors (hottest). The crown flame and the wand flame share one flame grade: red-orange tongue tips < orange outer < pale-yellow core (hottest). Crown + wand are the sheet's two charcoals (solid, opaque). 'alpha' (0-1, written to Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a; the fire material is alphaMode BLEND) makes the fire see-through: the licks and tongue tips thinnest, the body denser, the dark face nearly solid, the glowing holes solid; material.alpha multiplies every region (one knob for 'more / less see-through').

fire_shadow.note: the sheet's dark ember face under the crown (eyes + mouth sit inside it; wavy lower edge)

fire_deep.note: sheet chip DARK RED: the outer part of every flame lick, the free hand's claw, the leg / toe tips

fire.note: sheet chip ORANGE: the hellfire body block, arms, legs

fire_bright.note: sheet chip ORANGE 2 (brightened): flame tongues rising from the hem round the block

fire_core.note: the hot core block inside the body (the translucent shell shows it through)

hole_glow.note: eye + mouth hole floors: pale-yellow HOTTEST glow (the sheet's eye colour)

flame_tip.note: crown + wand flame tongue tips (cooler red-orange, most see-through)

flame_core.note: crown + wand flame inner core: pale-yellow HOTTEST

crown.note: sheet chip CHARCOAL: the crown band

crown_trim.note: sheet chip CHARCOAL 2: the band's edge trim ridges

crown_gem.note: the raised inner diamond on each boss (the sheet's inner diamond line)

horn.note: the two crescent horns (the sheet draws them darkest)

wand_prong.note: the claw prongs round the wand flame + the broken twig nubs
